historical_references.reference: Shahryar, also known as Muhammad Shah, was the eldest son of Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan and Mumtaz Mahal. He ascended to the throne in 1658, following his father's death.

Shahryar is also remembered for his notorious reign of terror, which occurred after his brother Aurangzeb's successful rebellion against him in 1658. During this time, Shahryar married and executed hundreds of women to prevent them from spreading rumors of his impotence.
